gtceu.multiblock.luv_fusion_reactor.desc: The Fusion Reactor MK 1 fuses elements into heavier ones in a round ring, 19 blocks across, the same size for every tier. It stores no energy: it builds a magnetic field of up to 1,000 from its energy hatches (1A LuV per tick while it builds), and a reaction starts only once the field has reached its minimum. Each run drains part of the field. It takes reactions up to a start class of 160 M. Energy hatches are optional in the structure, but without one the reactor builds no field and runs nothing. The field collapses when the structure breaks.
gtceu.multiblock.zpm_fusion_reactor.desc: The Fusion Reactor MK 2 fuses elements into heavier ones in a round ring, 19 blocks across, the same size for every tier. It stores no energy: it builds a magnetic field of up to 4,000 from its energy hatches (1A ZPM per tick while it builds), and a reaction starts only once the field has reached its minimum. Each run drains part of the field. It takes reactions up to a start class of 320 M. Energy hatches are optional in the structure, but without one the reactor builds no field and runs nothing. The field collapses when the structure breaks.
gtceu.multiblock.uv_fusion_reactor.descr: The Fusion Reactor MK 3 fuses elements into heavier ones in a round ring, 19 blocks across, the same size for every tier. It stores no energy: it builds a magnetic field of up to 16,000 from its energy hatches (1A UV per tick while it builds), and a reaction starts only once the field has reached its minimum. Each run drains part of the field. It takes reactions up to a start class of 640 M. Energy hatches are optional in the structure, but without one the reactor builds no field and runs nothing. The field collapses when the structure breaks.

af9.planetary_satellite.tooltip.0: §7GTNH's §fPlanetary Gas Siphon§7, §f13x23x13§7, built of Satellite Casing (Enriched Naquadah Trinium Europium Duranide), HSS-S frames and a column of Superconducting Coil Blocks up the middle of the tower.
af9.planetary_satellite.tooltip.1: §7Gathers neutron rays on a §fNeutron Ray Reflector§7 into §fliquid neutronium§7, 12 to 120 mB a run: the only source of neutronium. Iridium rolls 12-120 mB, osmiridium 36-120 mB, Unobtainium-Vibranium 96-120 mB. The reflector is not consumed but wears 1 point a run (1,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 runs).
af9.planetary_satellite.tooltip.2: §7Runs §fgtceu:neutron_collection§7 recipes: §f524,288 EU/t§7 (UV), 12 s, one reflector a run. Parallel hatches and batch mode work (every parallel rolls on its own; wear counts cycles). Overclocks are imperfect.
af9.planetary_satellite.tooltip.3: §7Hatches go in the Satellite Casing, never in the frames or the coils.

af9.space_elevator.tooltip.0: §7GTNH's tower on a cable into space, the pack's renewable ore source: its §bMining Modules§7 send §bMining Drones§7 to the asteroids and bring the ore home.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.1: §7The tower itself flies nothing: it holds the modules in its module slots and §fpowers§7 them from its energy and laser hatches. Each module is a small multiblock of its own, with its own screen, drone, hatches and cargo.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.2: §7A module takes a §bMining Drone§7 (not used up) in its screen, §e50-100 buckets§7 of §bhydrogen§7 and of a §bsupercooled coolant§7 (hydrogen, argon, xenon, endion by tier; into its §fCoolant Hatches§7) and §e4-32 amps of ZPM§7 from the tower for minutes. Out comes a random asteroid: §etens of stacks§7 of raw ore.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.3: §7Mk1 reaches the Overworld's ores, Mk2 the Nether's, Mk3 the End's, Mk4 the Asteroid Field's and the exotic ones. A better drone also gets more stacks.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.4: §7The tower's hatches fill the modules' buffers: Mk1 runs on one ZPM hatch (4A), Mk2 on two, Mk3 on four hatches (16A), Mk4 needs a laser hatch (32A), for every expedition at once.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.5: §735x35x43, GTNH's structure block for block: a floor of §fUltra High Strength Concrete§7, a tapering frame of §fBase Casing§7 and §fStress-Proof Casing§7 round a column of §bMotors§7 (88, all of one tier) with the §fCable§7 on top of its shaft, under the open sky. Formed, the cable runs up into the sky and the §bclimber§7 rides it.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.6: §7Tower hatches (maxima, any tier; ZPM ones fit the expeditions): 4 energy and 2 laser in the bottom centre casings. Each module has its own hatches in the casings round it: 2 item and 2 fluid input, 2 §fCoolant Hatches§7, 4 item and 4 fluid output.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.7: §bSpace Mining Modules§7 in the 12 module slots fly the expeditions, as in GTNH: MK-I 2 at once, MK-II 4, MK-III 8, each with the full hydrogen, coolant and energy. The §bMotors§7' tier powers 6 / 12 / 15 / 18 / 24 slots and modules up to its own tier. A module the motors do not power stays dark.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.8: §7Two sizes, as in GTNH (the size switch is on the tower's screen): the basic tower, or §eextended§7 with a ring of 47x47 round its foot and §b12 more module slots§7 (24). Motors MK-III and better have the slots for them.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.9: §7Or a §bliquid mission§7 (the arrows on a module's screen pick it): the same flight to a planet for one fluid of GTNH's Space Pumping table, §e8 to 17,920 buckets§7 a mission, into the module's §ffluid output hatches§7. Mk1 reaches planet types 2-3, Mk2 4-5 (the oils, helium-3), Mk3 6-7 (deuterium, tritium), Mk4 type 8.
af9.space_elevator.tooltip.10: §8After GTNH's Space Elevator (GTNH Intergalactic: minecraft7771, BlueWeabo; its design: Sampsa, Jimbno, Adam, Baunti). The screen says what it lacks while nothing flies.
af9.photolithography_line.tooltip.16: §dMulti-patterning§7: a §fscrewdriver§7 on the controller lets it print the mode one version above its own, exposing every layer twice: §c2x time§7, §c1.5x breaks§7, 2x OPC.
af9.photolithography_scanner.tooltip.9: §dMulti-patterning§7: a §fscrewdriver§7 on the controller lets a V1 scanner print 65nm, exposing every layer twice: §c2x time§7, §c1.5x breaks§7, 2x OPC. Takes §fcoated wafers§7 (Coater Track).
af9.high_temperature_precision_fabricato: §7Pulls the semiconductor boules: a §fseed crystal§7 on a §fgem holder rod§7 dipped into liquid §fpolysilicon§7 in a quartz crucible (worn a little each run).

§7A steel hall of firebox and solid casings with a steel gearbox. The only hatches are the §fPrecision Fabricator Input and Output Ports§7 and one energy hatch, in the bottom layer's solid casings. No maintenance, muffler, laser or parallel hatch.
§7Batch mode and perfect overclocking only. The voltage tier of the hatch is the heat: a hotter boule needs a higher tier.
af9.precision_port.input.tooltip.0: §7Input hatch and input bus in one: §f9 fluid tanks§7 (3x3), §f3 item inputs§7, §f1 non-consumable slot§7 and a §fghost circuit§7 (the circuit button on the screen).
af9.precision_port.input.tooltip.1: §7Only for the High Temperature Precision Fabricator.
af9.precision_port.output.tooltip.0: §7The output slot of the High Temperature Precision Fabricator: §f1 item§7.
af9.spent_fuel_pool.tooltip.0: §7Cooling decladding for every spent rod: water in, decladded dusts out. Slow and hands-free.
af9.spent_fuel_pool.tooltip.1: §7Same outputs as the macerators (thorium keeps its protactinium chance).
af9.spent_fuel_pool.tooltip.2: §7Parts are optional, with a maximum: §f2§7 energy, §f1+1§7 item, §f1§7 fluid hatch, §f1§7 maintenance, §f1§7 fluid input hatch (for the Xenoxid).

af9.fuel_fabrication_bay.tooltip.1: §7Uranium, HEU, LEP, HEP, MOX-1 to MOX-4, thorium, the neptunium to californium burners and breeder blankets.
af9.fuel_fabrication_bay.tooltip.2: §7Parts are optional, with a maximum: §f2§7 energy, §f2+1§7 item, §f1§7 fluid hatch, §f1§7 maintenance, §f1§7 fluid input hatch (for the Xenoxid).
af9.heat_exchanger.tooltip.0: §7Gives the heat of the §6hot FLiBe§7 from an §fExtreme Reactors§7 reactor run on FLiBe to §fDistilled Water§7: §bSupercritical Steam§7 and cooled FLiBe out, ready for the reactor again.
af9.heat_exchanger.tooltip.1: §7A closed loop: the salt is never used up. One run turns §f1,000 mB§7 of hot FLiBe into §f92,160 mB§7 of steam.
af9.heat_exchanger.tooltip.2: §7Parts are optional, with a maximum: §f2§7 energy, §f2§7 + §f2§7 fluid hatches, §f1§7 maintenance.
